title: Gloria Steinem, journalist and icon of feminism, dies aged 92
subhead: The trailblazing activist and leader of second-wave feminism died on Wednesday at the age of 92.

French government says SpaceX and Blue Origin pull out of Paris space summit
subhead: France's goverment said Thursday four US firms have cancelled their participation in next week's international space summit in the capital. Website Politico reported earlier that a White House official warned companies that attending the event could look like an endorsement of European Union policies.

title: Estonia elects consensus president, symbolizing unity in face of Russian destabilization attempts
subhead: Legal scholar Ülle Madise was elected on Wednesday to lead Estonia, with support from part of the parliamentary opposition. This result underscores the strength of Estonian democracy as Moscow aggressively steps up efforts to portray the former Soviet-occupied country's independence as illegitimate.

title: Leaked Spanish report  claims 'total permissiveness' of Morocco over Ceuta crisis
subhead: A leaked report alleges some Moroccan police officers guided crossings into the Spanish enclave, undermining Prime Minister Pedro Sanchez's insistance Rabat did not orchestrate the crisis.

title: War in Ukraine: Constant air raid alerts unsettle daily life in Kyiv
subhead: Since late August, sirens have sounded in the Ukrainian capital at an unprecedented rate not seen since the beginning of Russia's full-scale invasion in February 2022. This new reality has upended routines the city's 3.7 million residents.

subhead: Regarded as one of the most egalitarian countries in the world, the number of billionaires in Sweden has continued to rise while poverty has increased. Ahead of the September 13 elections, taxing the wealthiest has become a major campaign issue.

title: In southern Lebanon, complex Hezbollah disarmament and Israeli strikes leave residents desperate
subhead: The Lebanese Army has sought to deploy and residents have tried to return to their destroyed homes in the towns of Zawtar al-Gharbieh, Froun and Srifa, designated 'pilot zones' in July. Meanwhile, Israeli shelling continues nearby.
